links.outcome: Door-to-groin time and proportion receiving thrombectomy within 90 min before vs after AI implementation, plus clinical outcomes
links.effect: Thrombectomy within 90 min rose from 26.5% to 68.1% (p<0.001); median DTG fell from 109 to 75 min (p<0.001). No differences in TICI scores, length of stay, or mortality/hospice rates.
links.quote: The proportion of patients undergoing thrombectomy within 90 min increased significantly from 26.5% (95% CI 17.9-36.8%) to 68.1% (95% CI 60.0-75.5%, p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world clinical deployment and workflow impact (pre- vs post-implementation of Viz LVO) on door-to-puncture time, but tests the implementation of the AI tool itself rather than comparing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
